lines.t: Laundry on the bedroom floor
Bills stacked by the kitchen door
Coffee getting cold again
Same old week, same old spin
Neighbors yellin' down the hall
Sirens screamin' through it all
Nothin' here looks heavenly
But you keep showin' up for me
Not in flashes of gold light
Not in some dramatic sign
You're holy in the ordinary
Sacred in the small
In the middle of my Monday, you're the miracle in it all
Not a distant revelation, not a voice from outer space
You're the God who stays
I've been waiting for the grand, for the fire, for the plan
For a moment I could say that's the day you move my way
But you're as steady as the sun, rising when night is done
Every breath and every beat
Is evidence you're here with me
I was looking for the lightning, looking for the quake
Looking for a mountain moving moment just to wake my spirit
From the slumber of the nine to five grind
Searching for a signal that was never hard to find
The synesthetic of the radio, the rhythm of the rain
The quiet kind of comfort when I'm sifting through the pain
It's not a stage reduction or a neon light display
There's peace inside the chaos in the middle of the day
You don't leave when it gets heavy, you don't exit when it's dark
You're the anchor in the ocean, you're the logic in the love
From the kitchen to the pavement, every mile, every street
You're the only conversation that makes my life complete
If you walked on water once
You can walk into my mess
If you conquer death itself
You can handle all of this
You're holy in the ordinary, sacred in the small
Every little broken moment, you redeem it all
No, I don't need the lightning, just your faithful grace
You're the girl who stays
The girl who stays
Right here
